automation.publishRule: Redeploy only when verified evidence changes

methodology.formula: Overall completion = the sum of earned task points divided by the 100-point total. The current audit is 20/45 native and distribution points plus 19/45 MCP and marketplace points plus 5.5/10 launch and traction points = 44.5/100, displayed as 45%.

statusCredit.complete: Earned points equal the task weight
statusCredit.in_progress: Only the explicit earned points shown in this manifest

methodology.approvalRule: Account-gated identity, submission, and review tasks stay at zero until that gate is actually cleared. Completed submission preparation is split into its own engineering task.
methodology.etaRule: The headline hands-on range includes active, next, and account-unlockable work. It excludes Microsoft enterprise distribution and Google A2A because those are deferred product choices.
methodology.timeRule: Hands-on effort, 48–72 hours of clean-machine and energy soak, recurring operations, and external approval waits are deliberately reported separately.
methodology.healthRule: Public endpoint checks are guardrails only. Their results never change earned completion points.

gates: Apple Developer identity: 0–5+ business days after owner action
OpenAI publisher verification and directory review: unknown
Anthropic connector and MCPB directory review: unknown
npm namespace access: owner account unlock required
Microsoft publisher verification: unknown if enterprise distribution is activated

deliveryWorkstreams.name: macOS readiness audit
deliveryWorkstreams.detail: Native scope, risk, evidence, weights, and critical path locked.

deliveryWorkstreams.name: MCP and marketplace audit
deliveryWorkstreams.detail: Control plane, directory gates, publication state, and launch evidence locked.

deliveryWorkstreams.name: Status experience
deliveryWorkstreams.detail: Evidence model, responsive visualization, route coverage, and live-check surface.

deliveryWorkstreams.name: Validate, publish, and monitor
deliveryWorkstreams.detail: Cross-track reconciliation, production publish, smoke checks, and recurring audit.

phases.name: Native product and distribution
phases.summary: Alpha functionality is public; lifecycle automation, hardening, signing, and production QA carry most of the remaining work.

tasks.name: Core macOS app and alpha workflows
tasks.evidence: Folder import, on-device tagging, channels, static wallpaper application, exact restore, CLI control, and Aerial export ship; production polish remains.

tasks.name: Automatic rotation, lifecycle, and power scheduling
tasks.evidence: Rules currently evaluate on user actions. A next-boundary timer, sleep/wake handling, and display reconnect handling remain.

tasks.name: Performance, persistence, diagnostics, and accessibility hardening
tasks.evidence: The alpha baseline exists; production profiling, migration resilience, diagnostics, and deeper VoiceOver coverage remain.

tasks.name: Apple Developer identity
tasks.blockedReason: No Developer ID Application identity or notary profile is available.
tasks.evidence: Account enrollment is an owner gate and earns no engineering credit.

tasks.name: Signing, notarization, stapling, and Gatekeeper verification
tasks.evidence: Automation is drafted, but no signed artifact receives completion credit before real credentials and independent assessment.

tasks.name: GitHub release packaging and integrity automation
tasks.evidence: Public artifacts, source snapshot, dependency manifests, release notes, and checksums are live; immutable automation and polish remain.

tasks.name: Homebrew distribution
tasks.evidence: The first-party tap is live and hash-pinned; signed-artifact cutover and clean-machine install validation remain.

tasks.name: Universal binary, updater, and version automation
tasks.evidence: The current downloadable alpha is Apple-silicon-only and has no production updater.

tasks.name: QA and software supply-chain controls
tasks.evidence: Unit, integration, CI, CodeQL, dependency manifests, hashes, and secret scanning exist; stronger provenance and release policy remain.

tasks.name: Clean-machine, display, energy, and accessibility QA
tasks.evidence: Initial desktop and mobile site checks pass; hardware matrix, multi-display, sleep/wake, energy, and sustained accessibility verification remain.

tasks.name: Support, trust, and operational monitoring
tasks.evidence: Trust pages and intake paths are live; alert ownership, incident playbooks, and operating cadence remain.

phases.name: MCP and marketplaces
phases.summary: The local control plane is strong; production identity, remote control, publication, and directory approvals remain.

tasks.name: Local MCP control surface
tasks.evidence: Ten narrow, permission-annotated tools, stdio transport, MCPB packaging, and contract tests are complete.

tasks.name: Authenticated hosted reviewer service
tasks.evidence: The deterministic demo adapter is live; health is public and MCP access requires a bearer token.

tasks.name: Production device bridge
tasks.evidence: Enrollment and relay contracts exist; durable storage, recovery, and production enablement remain.

tasks.name: OpenAI submission engineering package
tasks.evidence: Metadata, policies, annotations, and positive and negative review fixtures are prepared.

tasks.name: OpenAI OAuth, publisher verification, and directory review
tasks.blockedReason: Production OAuth, publisher-console access, verified identity, and external review are required.
tasks.evidence: Submission preparation is credited separately; account verification and review earn zero until complete.

tasks.name: Anthropic local MCPB package
tasks.evidence: The local Claude-compatible bundle and manifest are packaged with the release.

tasks.name: Anthropic local directory submission and review
tasks.blockedReason: A qualifying publisher account and directory review are required.
tasks.evidence: Local installability does not count as directory acceptance.

tasks.name: Anthropic remote connector and plugin
tasks.evidence: The MCP core is reusable; remote authorization, plugin packaging, and submission-specific validation remain.

tasks.name: Publish-ready npm package artifact
tasks.evidence: The portable tarball is built and attached to the GitHub release.

tasks.name: npm namespace publication
tasks.blockedReason: An npm account with rights to the target namespace is required.
tasks.evidence: The package artifact is credited separately; registry publication is not.

tasks.name: MCP Registry manifest
tasks.evidence: The server manifest validates and names the public remote endpoint.

tasks.name: MCP Registry publication
tasks.evidence: Registry metadata is immutable by version, so publication waits for the canonical package.

tasks.name: Microsoft enterprise distribution
tasks.blockedReason: Deferred unless enterprise distribution is activated as a product choice.
tasks.evidence: Partner Center verification and a separate Microsoft submission shape would be required.

tasks.name: Gemini Spark compatibility
tasks.evidence: The portable MCP contract provides a base; compatibility validation and packaging remain.

tasks.name: Google A2A product path
tasks.blockedReason: Deferred because it is a separate agent and commercial product decision.
tasks.evidence: A2A is not presented as a thin repackaging of the current MCP service.

phases.name: Launch and traction
phases.summary: The public alpha foundation is live; repeatable acquisition, activation measurement, and support cadence remain.

tasks.name: Public alpha distribution foundation
tasks.evidence: The site, GitHub prerelease, Homebrew tap, policies, discussion, and public checks are live.

tasks.name: Founder-led community launch
tasks.evidence: GitHub launch communication is public; owner-controlled community, creator, and launch channels remain.

tasks.name: Measurement and support loop
tasks.evidence: Issue and support intake exist; privacy-preserving activation metrics, review cadence, and recurring triage remain.
